f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
h = 1.55

y_pix = 367.0
x_pix = 200.5

Xc = (x_pix - cx) / f * d

X_world = 0.7071 + d * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc * np.cos(theta_rad)

print(f"Lamp depth: {d:.4f} m, Xc: {Xc:.4f} m")
print(f"Lamp world position from obs 73: X = {X_world:.4f}, Y = {Y_world:.4f}")

# Pot 2:
y_pot = 475.0
x_pot = 84.9
d_pot = f * h / (y_pot - cy)
Xc_pot = (x_pot - cx) / f * d_pot
X_pot = 0.7071 + d_pot * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc_pot * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_pot = 0.7071 + d_pot * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc_pot * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Plant 2 depth: {d_pot:.4f} m, Xc: {Xc_pot:.4f} m")
print(f"Plant 2 world position from obs 73: X = {X_pot:.4f}, Y = {Y_pot:.4f}")
'
